summary: Econumo is a self-hosted application designed for tracking personal and family finances. It provides tools for managing multiple currencies, organizing joint accounts, and setting up structured budgets.
goodFor: Individuals or families seeking a dedicated, self-hosted platform to monitor and coordinate multi-currency household finances.
watchOut: With a modest community footprint and repository star count, you may encounter edge cases or have to rely primarily on your own troubleshooting.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on Docker, so you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
